description: This file defines API routes for managing gym membership plans and user memberships using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for creating, listing, updating, deleting plans, subscribing users to plans, canceling memberships, and retrieving current membership details.

methods.name: create_membership_plan
methods.description: Creates a new membership plan (admin only).

methods.name: update_membership_plan
methods.description: Updates an existing membership plan (admin only).

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes the current user to a membership plan.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the current user's active membership.

methods.name: current_membership
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's membership details.
